provenance.boundary: Immutable bounded structured excerpts; canonical GitHub subjects and exact candidate SHAs are retained. The fixture proves CP00-PROOF-LEVEL-CONTRADICTION does not arm when the issue excludes a proof level with 'do not implement' phrasing, even when the verb is not enumerated in PROOF_LEVEL_NEGATIVE_POLARITY_MARKERS. The clause-scoped structural-negation detector catches 'not' before the verb 'implement' the same way it does for 'not change' / 'not require' (#15463, #10831). See #15465 for the verb-vocabulary gap and #13367 for the original failing PR review.
